items.title: How Far Can Fabrinet Stock Fall While Its Business Accelerates?
items.summary: Fabrinet (FN) trades near $416, about 44% below the high it set in the past year. Its own results point the other way: fiscal 2026 ended in June with revenue up 36%, and management has guided the fiscal first quarter of 2027 to 43% growth at the midpoint. So how far can it fall once a real shock arrives.
